theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e x : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2 = inner ℝ x a ^ 2 + inner ℝ x e ^ 2
